headline: Tractor Supply Digital Sales Rise 16% as Cost Cuts Target 9% Operating Margin
summary: Tractor Supply posted a 16% jump in third-quarter digital sales while management targets a 9% operating margin supported by operational cost discipline.
why: Tractor Supply is the largest rural lifestyle retailer in the U.S., offering insight into consumer spending patterns across non-urban markets.

impacts.name: Tractor Supply Company
impacts.why: Double-digit digital expansion combined with cost reductions underpins margin stabilization targets.
